name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Praxis.rankOne_passing_iff_witness
title: Rank-one template: a nonzero symmetric rank-one matrix passes the Booleanity and constraint tests iff the system has a Boolean witness
statement: For a rank-one constraint system over a field K with unknowns w_1..w_n (index 0 is the constant 1) and constraints (a_t . w)(b_t . w) = c_t . w, consider the symmetric rank-one matrix W = kappa v v^T (entries kappa v_i v_j) with kappa != 0 and v != 0. W passes the Booleanity tests W_jj = W_0j for every j and the constraint tests a_t^T W b_t = sum_j W_0j c_t,j for every t if and only if the system has a witness w with w_0 = 1, every w_j in {0,1} and every constraint satisfied. This is Lemma 4.3 of Praxis (Tse-Vanjani-Vesely, ePrint 2026/2971) in explicit coordinates; it shows that deciding whether a template instance admits a usable stack of rank one is deciding satisfiability, so an admissibility predicate for an assumption covering Praxis cannot be efficiently checkable (note pq-we-praxis-bilinear-substitutes).
